themes.name: Modern rustic witch
themes.description: Bosque noturno, cobre envelhecido, pergaminho e verde-musgo em uma composição contemporânea, sóbria e concentrada; a linguagem simbólica é apenas visual e permanece separada do conteúdo científico.
themes.descriptionEn: Night woodland, aged copper, parchment, and moss green in a contemporary, sober, focused composition; the symbolic language is visual only and remains separate from scientific content.

themes.name: Total orange
themes.description: Preto e laranja-fogo com sigilo orbital e Campo Total 4–3–3: onze rotas reais organizadas por função primária, mobilidade e cobertura coordenada, inspiradas na ocupação inteligente dos espaços do Futebol Total neerlandês de 1974; homenagem conceitual autoral, sem afiliação oficial.
themes.descriptionEn: Black and fire orange with an orbital sigil and a Total Field 4–3–3: eleven real routes organized by primary responsibility, mobility, and coordinated coverage, inspired by the intelligent use of space in Dutch Total Football in 1974; an original conceptual tribute with no official affiliation.

themes.name: Orbital arcana
themes.description: Cabine clínica cósmica com constelações, órbitas, violeta arcano e cobre estelar; fantasia visual autoral separada do conteúdo científico.
themes.descriptionEn: A cosmic clinical cockpit with constellations, orbital lines, arcane violet, and stellar copper; original visual fantasy kept separate from scientific content.

themes.name: Aerospace
themes.description: Central de missão noturna, alto contraste, ciano orbital e âmbar de prioridade.
themes.descriptionEn: Night mission control with high contrast, orbital cyan, and priority amber.

themes.name: Aerospace light
themes.description: Cabine diurna limpa, técnica e luminosa, preservando a navegação aeroespacial.
themes.descriptionEn: A clean, technical daylight cockpit that retains aerospace navigation cues.

themes.name: Rustic light
themes.description: Leitura conservadora em papel quente, madeira discreta e contraste sóbrio.
themes.descriptionEn: Conservative reading on warm paper tones with restrained wood accents and sober contrast.

themes.name: Essential dark
themes.description: Escuro neutro para leitura prolongada, sem efeitos decorativos.
themes.descriptionEn: Neutral dark reading for long sessions without decorative effects.

themes.name: Minimal
themes.description: Hierarquia direta, poucas cores e máxima redução de ruído visual.
themes.descriptionEn: Direct hierarchy, few colors, and maximum reduction of visual noise.

themes.name: Sepia
themes.description: Tonalidade de arquivo clínico clássico com contraste confortável.
themes.descriptionEn: Classic clinical archive tones with comfortable contrast.

themes.name: Oceanic
themes.description: Azuis profundos e turquesa para uma navegação calma e técnica.
themes.descriptionEn: Deep blues and turquoise for calm, technical navigation.

themes.name: Clinical green
themes.description: Verde técnico inspirado em monitores, com alertas âmbar controlados.
themes.descriptionEn: Monitor-inspired technical green with controlled amber alerts.

themes.name: Natural
themes.description: Tons minerais e vegetais suaves para leitura equilibrada.
themes.descriptionEn: Soft mineral and botanical tones for balanced reading.

themes.name: Forest
themes.description: Verde profundo, madeira e sinalização orgânica para foco silencioso.
themes.descriptionEn: Deep green, wood, and organic cues for quiet focus.

themes.name: Arcane academy
themes.description: Academia fantástica original, com pergaminho, constelações e dourado discreto, sem marcas licenciadas.
themes.descriptionEn: An original scholarly fantasy with parchment, constellations, and restrained gold, without licensed brands.

themes.name: Editorial hero
themes.description: Energia de quadrinhos original, tipografia forte e cores de ação, sem personagens ou marcas licenciadas.
themes.descriptionEn: Original comic-book energy, strong typography, and action colors, without licensed characters or brands.

themes.name: Modern serious
themes.description: Portal institucional contemporâneo, sóbrio e orientado à evidência.
themes.descriptionEn: A contemporary, sober institutional portal designed around evidence.
